versions.content: Compatible with iterative design Type: valid Description: Support iterative design as mandated by AUTOSAR methodology. Rationale: It is rare that development of any product is finished without any design changes. A design change invariably requires iteration of some portion of the design stages. AUTOSAR tools will be used iteratively and this includes ECU configuration. Use Case: Product design change after configuration of an ECU which requires a new ECU configuration to be developed. 5 18 of 35  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 85: AUTOSAR_RS_ECUConfiguration Requirements on ECU Configuration AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Dependencies: This is closely related with the usage of the System Constraint/Configuration Description. [RS_ECUC_00074] Supporting Material: 
